name: Qlmatch Packer
description: Deploys the external Node.js qlmatch-packer (+ Node 22 runtime) to every managed host after setup / "Update Plugins", and makes demo-management recognise the .qlmatch/.replay.json.gz files it produces (the .packer.log it also writes is deliberately never surfaced there). Cvars (qlx_qlmatchNameTemplate, qlx_qlmatchRcloneTargets) are read straight from an instance's server.cfg -- there is no Plugins-tab UI for them since the plugin that used to own that manifest was retired; set them by hand for now. This addon's own settings only control whether the replay sidecar shows up in the Demos widget.

global.label: Show .replay.json.gz files
global.description: List the merged-replay sidecar in the Demos widget. Purely a listing switch -- the file is still written on the host either way.
